D: Retired superheroes investigate the murder of one of their own.
P: Serve the beans when Rorschach eats them cold from the tin.
S: Cannellini beans in olive oil with garlic, rosemary and chili, baked beans on the side
Cannellini beans warmed in olive oil with garlic, rosemary and chilli, crushed a little, piled on grilled sourdough. Serve one tin cold on the side for authenticity.
Crisp chickpea flour onion fritters with mint yogurt and tamarind chutney

Shredded onion and chilli in a spiced chickpea batter, fried into crisp tangled bhajis with mint yoghurt and a sharp tamarind chutney. Thinly slice 3 onions and mix with 1 chopped green chilli, a handful of coriander, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp turmeric, half a tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 150g chickpea flour and about 80ml water to make a thick batter that coats the onions. Drop rough spoonfuls into oil at 175C and fry 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g yoghurt with chopped mint and serve with tamarind chutney.
M: Salt, pepper and smoked paprika brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with pickles, white bread and a black coffee barbecue sauce. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt, 2 tbsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper at 70C. Rest 1 hour. Simmer 250ml barbecue sauce with 80ml strong black coffee and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes. Slice the brisket thick and serve with the sauce, dill pickles and white bread.
Chicken thighs simmered with ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and cream, rice and naan
Chicken thighs in a curry of onion, ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and cream, simmered 30 minutes, basmati and naan.
W: Butter cookies with yellow icing, a black smile and a drop of strawberry jam
Vanilla sugar cookies rolled 5mm, cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, iced yellow with a smiley face and a splash of jam.
K: Coffee infused bourbon with maple syrup and bitters over a big ice cube

Coffee-infused bourbon stirred with maple and chocolate bitters over a big ice cube, finished with an orange twist and three coffee beans. Steep 2 tbsp coarsely ground coffee in 240ml bourbon for 30 minutes, then strain through a paper filter. In a jug with ice, stir the bourbon with 4 tsp maple syrup and 8 dashes chocolate or aromatic bitters for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over one large cube each. Twist orange peel over each and float 3 coffee beans.
